## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed, signed off and follow Conventional Commits.
- [ ] Changed behavior has meaningful regression coverage.
- [ ] Relevant style, static, Unit and Core/native checks pass.
- [ ] README and both manual languages reflect any behavior change.
- [ ] Repeated independent review has no unresolved findings.
